{{Top|leg}}
'''Flexisteel''' or '''flexsteel''' was a strong, durable material used in engineering. It was a stainless material that had metallic characteristics, but was very pliable as well.

Flexisteel was used by [[Beryl Chiffonage]] to form the tow cable of a [[power harpoon launcher]] for the [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].

It was often used to make [[flexcord]] and could also be layered to form exceptionally durable starship armor plating. Flexisteel was used to create surgical devices such as scalpels.<ref name="MedStar I: Battle Surgeons">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>

[[Corusca fishermen]] used cables made from flexisteel when mining [[Corusca gem/Legends|Corusca gems]] on [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]]. They would typically attach an [[energy purse seine]] or flexisteel cable net with a thick mesh to several space-capable one-man [[Skiff/Legends|skiffs]] and one trawler. The trawler would be used to provide propulsion for the entire group. Meanwhile, the skiffs would keep the net steady.

[[Fencing]] [[rapier]]s, including [[saber]]s, [[foil]]s, and [[epée]]s, were made of flexisteel.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
